observation.description: The paved scaffold's very first generate warns about the scaffold itself: `snapback new my-app --template react` ships a `createTodo` mutation that `snapback generate` immediately flags as 'degraded createTodo … Add `result: results.document("table")` … and regenerate'. A first-hour consumer's untouched starter should generate advisory-clean, or the advisory should not apply to the paved declarative `returns: returnBinding(...)` form.
evidence: codegen summary output retained in the capsule's scenario g1.scaffold-generate-build-start-inspect-stop

competitorOutcome.description: No frozen 0102/0115 evidence bears on Snapback's own scaffolder polish; the general reference standard is that first-party starters (e.g. create-vite, npm create convex) generate without tool-emitted fix-me advisories on the untouched template.

mustNotRegress: Codegen's honest degraded-contract advisory itself — the fix is to make the template clean, never to silence the advisory.
smallestCoherentFix: Ship the react template's createTodo with a complete declared result contract (or teach the advisory that a declarative returnBinding plan already fixes the result type), so a fresh scaffold generates with zero advisories.
acceptanceWitness: Fresh external `snapback new x --template react && snapback generate snapback` prints a summary with zero degraded advisories; a template acceptance assertion pins it.
